source: ESA WorldCover 10 m land-cover classes (v100 2020, v200 2021): the class codes and names only

biomes.name: Forest
biomes.description: Woods and plantations: bark, leaf litter and the dark under the canopy.

biomes.name: Scrub
biomes.description: Thickets, heath and thorn: dry, tangled and sunlit.

biomes.name: Town
biomes.description: Streets, roofs, gardens and park ponds: where most people are.

biomes.name: Snowfield
biomes.description: Permanent snow, glaciers and the cold water at their edges.

biomes.name: Open Water
biomes.description: Lakes, rivers, reservoirs and the sea.

biomes.name: Mangrove
biomes.description: Tidal forest: roots, mud and brackish water.

biomes.name: Tundra
biomes.description: Moss, lichen and bog pools on cold open ground.
